evals.prompt: I renamed the build script and added a new env var, update the docs
evals.expected_output: Diffs the branch against main, maps the change to README (commands, env vars) per the repo's doc table, re-reads the README and the changed package.json before editing, edits only the stale sentences, and verifies the new command exists.

evals.prompt: sync docs for the staged changes
evals.expected_output: Uses git diff --staged as the scope; if the staged diff is only generated or lock files, stops and says no docs need updates.
